About Me

Translating design concepts into clear, realistic visual stories.

I'm an Interior Designer and a 2026 graduate of the Faculty of Fine Arts (Capital University), specializing in Interior Architecture with a Very Good overall grade. My core interest lies in 3D visualization and interior space design.

Through academic milestones, professional training at Nabil Raouf Designs, and real-world projects, I focus heavily on material selection, lighting accuracy, and intricate detail — bringing architectural concepts to life with warmth and precision.

How I Work

My visualization process

A clear, five-step workflow that moves from first understanding to a polished, presentation-ready result.

01

Design Understanding

Understanding concepts, spatial requirements, and references before a single line is drawn.

02

Material & Mood

Exploring colors, materials, textures, and the atmosphere the space should evoke.

03

3D Modeling

Translating the design into a detailed, accurate 3D model of every element.

04

Lighting & Rendering

Developing realistic materials, lighting, and camera composition for photoreal results.

05

Final Presentation

Refining images and presenting the design with clarity and confidence.
